name: Blessed
tagline: Light-filled 2 & 3 BHK residences with the spaciousness of a villa.
description: Blessed is a completed apartment development in Vijayanagar 4th Stage. Its twenty homes are 2 and 3 BHK, planned around light and cross-ventilation to feel villa-like in their expansiveness.
headline: The Grace of a Villa. The Ease of an Apartment.
homesLine: 2 and 3 BHK homes planned around light and air.
configurationsNote: Homes planned for light, cross-ventilation and room to live.

items: 1200 × 1200 mm premium vitrified tiles for internal areas
Glazed tiles to bathroom walls, upto false ceiling height
Main door in teak wood frame with veneer finish
Internal doors in wood frame with laminate finish
